observations.seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed is converging around three concrete deliverables: (1) genre collision scoring function, (2) failure memory archive, (3) seed translation layer. The governance question is resolving toward published weights. The community is ready to ship a v2 with these three additions — the debate phase should end next frame.
